title: A new gold decision is announced only by an ephemeral, freshly mounted live region (or not at all)
expected: A persistent live region announces every new decision (arrival), not only a rung climb, so a screen-reader user notices a gold event within seconds.
got: The persistent sr-only live region (rungSays) speaks only on a rung step up; a first sighting on a calm rung returns null. Arrivals go through the ticker, whose role=status node is remounted with content via key (a live region inserted already populated is unreliably announced) and is shown only when the form allows it; a docked Tumbler stays silent; the window is shown non-focusable on arrival, so focus never moves. Only the OS notification remains.
l2_priority: Check in a screen reader whether an arrival is spoken (NVDA/Narrator). Precondition: native shell (Windows) with a screen reader; in preview only the DOM can be confirmed (is the live node present before its text changes?) and speech cannot be proven, so resolve uncertain if not reproducible. Needs a mock attention event whose deadline is more than 2 h away (calm rung).
suggested_acceptance: Add one persistent polite live region fed by the arrival sentence (always mounted, text swapped), independent of ticker visibility and dock state; test that it holds the arrival sentence.

title: Ticker messages (arrival, snooze acknowledgement, receipt) vanish in 2.5-6 s and cannot be paused
expected: Time-limited messages pause on hover and focus (as the toast layer does) or can be re-read; the snooze acknowledgement stays readable at 200% zoom.
got: TICKER_MS is 6000 ms default and 2500 ms for receipt and info (the snooze ack uses info); the timer is a bare setTimeout with no hover or focus hold, and queued tickers replace it. Toasts in the same client hold on mouseenter/focus.
l2_priority: Snooze a deal and time how long the acknowledgement is readable; hover it. Precondition: preview /tumbler.html with a GATE whose deadline is over 45 min (snooze eligible).
suggested_acceptance: Reuse toast hold semantics on the ticker (hover/focus pause, on-screen time scaled to text length, or keep the last ticker line in the stack form).

title: Tumbler is a fixed-grid px layout with nowrap/ellipsis/line-clamp; 200% text zoom likely clips the decision and the safe-default line
expected: At 200% zoom the question, amount, 'If you do nothing' line and actions stay readable and reachable (WCAG 1.4.4 / 1.4.10).
got: Native forms are fixed 440x(152-336) px windows; rows have fixed heights (head 22 px, actions 24 px, line-height 17 px); headline, owner line and silence line use white-space:nowrap or -webkit-line-clamp:2 with overflow hidden; Tumbler root font is 13 px. The token file states the fixed grid is intentional. The approval window, by contrast, sizes in rem/flex and scrolls (overflow-y:auto).
l2_priority: Open /tumbler.html with browser zoom 200% and a card form; check whether the safe-default line and all actions are visible. Precondition: preview with a long-headline mock deal; native-shell zoom behaviour is an accepted unverified gap (STATUS B8), so a native result stays uncertain if not reproducible.
suggested_acceptance: Let the Tumbler card grow or scroll with text scale, or move full text to a scrollable region; at minimum guarantee the safe-default line never truncates.

title: Snooze exists only inside the Details popover; where focus goes after the card disappears is unproven
expected: Snooze is findable by name from the card and focus lands somewhere meaningful afterwards.
got: The card shows Review and Withdraw plus a button named 'Details: <headline>'; 'Remind me in 30 min' and 'Let it lapse' sit behind it in a popover. Keyboard-reachable (Tab, Enter, Tab) but a screen-reader user is never told Snooze exists. A snoozed GATE is dropped from the snapshot, so the focused card vanishes and the form switches to a non-focusable ticker; no focus target is set.
l2_priority: Keyboard-only: open card, Tab to Details, snooze, observe document.activeElement afterwards. Precondition: preview with GATE deadline over 45 min.
suggested_acceptance: Mention Snooze in the card's spoken name or the Details button label; after a snooze move focus to the puck or a status line.

title: Hold vs gate on the puck is told by gold vs coral only, in a small aria-hidden SVG; the ticker is click-only
expected: Decision kind is available as text or shape, and every mouse action has a keyboard equivalent.
got: Beads and ring differ by colour class (hold/gate, gold/coral) inside an aria-hidden SVG; the 28x96 tab form is a vertical 12 px label. Cards and stack rows do carry text chips (Needs you/Paused/In approval) and the puck accessible name carries the count, so the loss is for sighted low-vision users reading the puck itself. The ticker div has onClick with no role, tabindex or key handler (the stack is reachable from the puck instead).
l2_priority: View the puck at 200% with one gate and one hold. Precondition: mock data containing both kinds.
suggested_acceptance: Add a shape or text cue for hold (for example the word 'paused' in the puck name) and make the ticker a keyboard-activatable button.

title: Money actions need a fixed 1200 ms hold (pointer or Space) with no alternative for users who cannot sustain a hold
expected: A documented accessible alternative to hold-to-confirm, or an accepted rationale.
got: HoldGesture/HoldButton complete only on an unbroken 1200 ms hold; Enter and click never complete (by design: Enter never releases money). Keyboard is operable (hold Space) and the hold is announced (Keep holding / Confirmed, progressbar named). Tremor or switch users have no shorter path.
l2_priority: Hold Space on the money button with a screen reader running. Precondition: preview /approval.html, unlocked review on a deal with a payable action.
suggested_acceptance: Accept as a safety control; record in accepted-gaps with the keyboard path stated, optionally a settings-scaled hold time.

title: Structural a11y test covers the Main console only; Tumbler and approval windows have no audit and no screen-reader session has been run
expected: A named-controls/ARIA audit and a keyboard-session test on the money-critical windows (approval, Tumbler).
got: console/a11y.test.tsx audits Main layers (names, labels, one h1, one tab stop). Tumbler and approval tests assert only a handful of aria-labels but no whole-window audit. nameOf falls back to title, so title-only names pass. UX-AUDIT states no screen-reader session has been run.
l2_priority: Run an NVDA pass over approval.html. Precondition: Windows host with NVDA, preview server on 1430.
suggested_acceptance: Reuse the audit() helper against approval and Tumbler renders; fail on title-only names for icon buttons.

title: Money flow is keyboard-operable by construction with sound modal and focus handling
got: Sheet is role=dialog aria-modal with a labelled heading, heading focus on open (never a button), Tab trap, Esc on the top layer, focus returned on close; modal focus guard; Space-hold; Enter never pays; typed-name confirmation has an aria-live match status; countdowns are role=timer aria-live=off with a spoken aria-label; no tabindex above 0 anywhere in client src; every outline:none has a replacement focus style (inset focus ring, slider thumb ring, or a programmatically focused heading by design).
l2_priority: Tab through approval.html and confirm order matches visual order. Precondition: preview server on 1430.

title: Contrast, names, motion and snooze safety are strong on the Tumbler
got: Contrast computed from tokens (dark): gold-l on panel 12.40, bg 13.44, panel3 10.23; gold fill 9.68; text 14.95; muted 8.73; dim 5.91 (4.88 on panel3); teal-l 12.15, coral-l 10.50, red-l 8.50, ok 10.53; focus ring gold-l 12.40 on panel; light theme dim 7.05, gold-l 7.73, focus pp-blue 4.44 (passes 3:1 non-text). Text-plus-colour state chips; reduced motion handled three ways (OS media query, in-app calm class, .reduced class); puck, tab, card, stack and handoff all have spoken names; Snooze exists only above 45 min and Rust re-pierces at the 15-minute rung, so a snooze can never carry a decision past its deadline; nothing steals focus (Ctrl+Shift+Space summons and focuses; Tab/Enter/Esc/W handled).
